_help: Problem reports -> GitHub Issues. Deploy build/report-worker.js on Cloudflare Workers (free), then paste the worker URL here. Empty = students use 'Copy report'.

messages.title: Do these 3 things (all teams)
messages.text: Your robot still has the OLD program and the OLD wiring. That is why STOP looks pressed and nothing moves.
steps: Connect to the robot Wi-Fi → the page asks "Update the robot" → click Update (2 min)
Then it asks "Standard wiring" → click Apply
Move the plugs on the VMX: START 8 · STOP 9 · RESET 10 · Lift 12 · Pusher 13 · Green 14 · Red 15
🧪 Test → every row should be green → Simple tasks → 📨 Send results (press it ONCE)

messages.title: Robot drives by itself in Teleop
messages.text:
Your START and RESET buttons "press themselves" every 2–3 seconds, and START runs a full routine. That is the driving you saw.
The 3 steps above fix it. Until then: don't use Teleop.

messages.title: Wheels: the robot can't find the Titan
messages.text: No wheel can move until this is fixed.
steps: Titan lights on (3.3V / 5V next to 12V IN)
CAN cable: yellow → H, green → L, at the Titan AND at the VMX

messages.title: Your wheels are fine ✅ — STOP is blocking them
messages.text:
All 4 wheels turned in the test. Forward / turn / lift fail only because STOP is still on the old pin 13.
Do the 3 steps above. Also: Rear L and Rear R cables are swapped on the Titan — after "Apply", plug Rear L into M2 and Rear R into M3.

messages.title: Your wheel settings are mixed up
messages.text: Three wheels are set to the same Titan port (M0). "Apply" fixes it (M0 FL · M1 FR · M2 RL · M3 RR).

_help_messages: Messages shown on the student page. to = all, or the end of the robot Wi-Fi name (Team-1). Change id to show a message again.
